title: Generative editor · Source and Stream (mockup)
lede: `apps/workspace.bl`: the Source/Stream workspace in Carbon and Snow. Forms are real, and so are evaluation receipts and Made/Verified/Saved/Live. The model and the runtime are mocks.
hints: **Select a form**: click an atom, or a bracket for the whole collection. Then `j` `k` `h` `l` move by structure (the Ctrl+J/K/H/L contract, web-safe keys), `⏎` evaluates, `Esc` clears. At a boundary the selection stays and the inspector says why. It never wraps.

**Evaluate form** is an intent carrying path · revision · form id. The browser and the server both refuse a stale revision. The server reads the file, evaluates the form in its mock runtime and appends a receipt: to the Stream when the source is a pane inside it, otherwise to the file's own Activity.

**Candidate v1**: Verify runs checks on the server. Save source is basis-guarded and bumps the file's revision, so old receipts and comments show as earlier revisions. Make Live swaps what the image runs without writing the file. Each is a separate decision.
`/` opens Search actions, the one action catalogue. `s` switches perspective, `a` toggles Activity, `t` toggles Carbon/Snow.
